observed.caption: A weathered green pillar postbox stands on a sidewalk with a street, parked cars, trees, buildings and a billboard in the background.
observed.description: A cylindrical green pillar postbox with chipped red paint at its base and rim stands in the center foreground on a paved concrete sidewalk. The postbox has a rectangular mail slot with embossed lettering on either side and a small keyhole below. Behind it is an asphalt street with a curb and traffic island, with several parked cars visible on both sides including a black SUV on the left and a black Volvo SUV on the right. Large leafy trees and a smaller tree line the opposite side of the street, partially obscuring a beige multi-story building with rectangular windows. A tall vertical advertising billboard with red and white coloring and images of drinks stands on the right side of the background, and a palm tree is visible further right. A black-and-white striped bollard is positioned on the sidewalk behind the postbox. The lighting is natural daylight under overcast conditions.
